race.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden
race.verdict: LET'S SMASH IT has to prove his stamina for this far but is still the most persuasive option in a trappy-looking maiden. Support for Ossie's Lodge on his return to the track would look very significant, while Meet The Day could be a factor on debut. LET'S SMASH IT (IRE) OSSIE'S LODGE (IRE) MEET THE DAY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Let's Smash It (9/4), Meet The Day (4/1), Ossie's Lodge (5/1), Kigalienne (6/1), Seventh Sea (10/1), Yolanda Be Cool (12/1), Copper Dog (12/1), Lilannbee (12/1), Monodora (20/1), Sierra's Dream (25/1), The Lodge Lane (33/1), Ferreshana (50/1), Sargent Lightfoot (50/1), Threebiggulps (66/1), Cape Blue Point (66/1)
